verdict.rationale: Gram's Control Plane explicitly generates hosted MCP servers from first-party sources — either an OpenAPI document or a TypeScript Functions project — with the platform handling deployment, protocol compliance, and connection URLs, meaning no manual protocol plumbing is required. CLI and dashboard workflows (stage, deploy, install as MCP server) reinforce this end-to-end path from API/code to hosted MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification beyond vendor docs, and more detail on custom-code support beyond TypeScript Functions.
